text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. To address safety concerns and congestion in the area of Valleyfield Junior School (35 Saskatoon Drive), it is recommended that the current school bus loading zone on Saskatoon Drive be extended further west and a new additional school bus loading zone be created on Benbow Road. In addition, the current "No Parking, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday" regulation on the south side of Saskatoon Drive and on east side of Benbow Road (along the frontage and flank of the school), be amended to create a "Maximum 10 Minute Limit, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday" parking regulation to address the need for additional drop-off and pick-up space for parents of attending school children.
